audit: erun push --version <VERSION>
==> Pushing
==> Push failed after <ELAPSED>
step timing (ordered by duration):
  push (failed) [<ELAPSED>] — no credential is configured for ghcr.io: no docker config entry, no gh session, and no GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN.
GHCR never accepts an anonymous push, so this is checked before the build rather than at the push, after every image has been built for every architecture.
From a shell in this environment (erun open), authenticate with one of:
  gh auth login -h github.com -s write:packages,read:packages
  docker login ghcr.io
then re-run erun release (or erun push).
